resources.string: Show trivia slides before a film starts. With an AI provider set up above, it writes the slides and a short quiz (one request per film when you press play; each result is kept so replaying it is free). Without one, or if it is unavailable, slides come from the film's Wikipedia article.
Up / Down to choose · Enter to answer · Esc to skip the pre-show
Play trailers of similar titles (from More Like This) before a film starts. Escape skips them all.
Plays an inaudible signal during the pre-show so an HDMI receiver does not drop its input between trailers, which can cause a dip and a Dolby flash at the start of each one.
Keep audio output awake for music
Plays an inaudible signal while music plays so an HDMI receiver does not drop its input between tracks. Try it if you hear a dip or see the format indicator flash when a track changes.
Trailers and trivia that play before a film starts.
No AI provider is set up, so trivia comes from Wikipedia and has no quiz. For AI-written trivia, set a provider (OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic and others), model and key under Discover, then AI.
Plays the film or show\'s main theme quietly while the trivia cards are on screen. It is found on YouTube and may not exist for every title.
Plays the main theme behind a film\'s or show\'s details page. It stays silent while a hero trailer has its sound on.
